pronote.methodTitle: How do you want to sign in?
pronote.methodText: Find your school or paste its PRONOTE address.
pronote.cityText: Then pick your school from the list
pronote.entTitle: Do you usually sign in through your ENT?
pronote.entText: Pick your school: Piéride opens your ENT's sign-in page in a secure window.
pronote.searchText: Type the name of your town: PRONOTE schools around it show up from nearest to farthest.
pronote.noFilterMatch: No school in the list matches this filter.
pronote.searchFailed: Search isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment, or enter your school's address.
pronote.urlHelp: Where do I find this address?
pronote.urlStep1: Open PRONOTE in your browser, from your ENT or your school's website.
pronote.urlStep2: Copy the address shown in the browser's address bar.
pronote.urlStep3: Paste it here: Piéride trims the end of the address for you.
pronote.instanceFailed: No PRONOTE answers at this address. Check it, or search for your school by town.
pronote.loginText: Your school's sign-in page, or your ENT's, opens in a separate window. Sign in as usual.
pronote.safeText: Piéride isn't affiliated with PRONOTE or your ENT. The page opens in a secure window: Piéride never reads or keeps your password.
pronote.waiting: Sign in in the window that just opened.
pronote.closed: The window was closed before you finished signing in.
pronote.pinText: PRONOTE is asking for the PIN you chose to protect your account.

errors.login_open: The sign-in window is already open.
errors.AuthenticationError: PRONOTE refused the sign-in. Try again.
errors.ServiceUnavailable: PRONOTE isn't responding right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.SecurityChallenge: PRONOTE is asking for a check Piéride can't handle yet.
errors.LoginBlocked: PRONOTE wants you to change your password or set up two-factor authentication. Do it on the PRONOTE website first, then come back here.
